exam_set.title: Practice Set 4
exam_set.description: Textbook Practice — Book 1, Chapter 3, Practice Set 4

questions.jp: 再帰呼び出しの説明はどれか。
questions.romaji: Saiki yobidashi no setsumei wa dore ka.

options.label: ア
options.jp: あらかじめ決められた順番ではなく、起きた事象に応じた処理を行うこと
options.romaji: Arakajime kimerareta junban dewa naku, okita jishō ni ōjita shori o okonau koto

options.label: イ
options.jp: 関数の中で自分自身を用いた処理を行うこと
options.romaji: Kansū no naka de jibun jishin o mochiita shori o okonau koto
options.en: A function performs processing using itself.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 処理が終了した関数をメモリから消去せず、必要になったとき再び用いること
options.romaji: Shori ga shūryō shita kansū o memorī kara shōkyo sezu, hitsuyō ni natta toki futatabi mochiiru koto

options.label: エ
options.jp: 処理に失敗したときに、その処理を呼び出す直前の状態に戻すこと
options.romaji: Shori ni shippai shita toki ni, yobidasu chokuzen no jōtai ni modosu koto
options.en: Restore state before a failed call.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
A recursion is a mirror: function asks itself smaller version.

Technical breakdown:
A recursive function calls itself, usually with smaller input and base case.

Japanese keywords to remember:
再帰 = saiki = recursion

Why the best solution works:
イ states self-call.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア is event-driven. ウ is caching/reuse. エ is rollback.

Memory trick:
Recursion = self-call.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: 再入可能プログラムの特徴はどれか。
questions.romaji: Sainyū kanō puroguramu no tokuchō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which is a characteristic of a reentrant program?

options.label: ア
options.jp: 主記憶上のどこのアドレスに配置しても、実行することができる。
options.romaji: Shu kioku-jō no doko no adoresu ni haichi shite mo, jikkō suru koto ga dekiru.
options.en: It can execute at any main-memory address.

options.label: イ
options.jp: 手続の内部から自分自身を呼び出すことができる。
options.romaji: Tetsuzuki no naibu kara jibun jishin o yobidasu koto ga dekiru.
options.en: It can call itself from inside a procedure.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: 必要な部分を補助記憶装置から読み込みながら動作する。
options.romaji: Hitsuyō na bubun o hojo kioku sōchi kara yomikominagara dōsa suru.
options.en: It runs while loading needed parts from auxiliary storage.

options.label: エ
options.jp: 複数のタスクからの呼び出しに対して、並行して実行されても、それぞれのタスクに正しい結果を返す。
options.romaji: Fukusū no tasuku kara no yobidashi ni taishite, heikō shite jikkō sarete mo, sorezore no tasuku ni tadashii kekka o kaesu.
options.en: Even when concurrently called by multiple tasks, it returns correct results to each.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Many people can use safe vending machine without mixing orders.

Technical breakdown:
Reentrant code avoids corrupt shared state, so concurrent calls remain independent.

Japanese keywords to remember:
再入可能 = sainyū kanō = reentrant

Why the best solution works:
エ defines independent concurrent calls.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア is relocatable. イ is recursion. ウ is overlay loading.

Memory trick:
Reentrant: re-enter safely.

Correct answer: エ

questions.jp: Javaにおいて、よく使われる機能などを再利用できるようにコンポーネント化するための仕様はどれか。
questions.romaji: Java ni oite, yoku tsukawareru kinō nado o sairiyō dekiru yō ni konpōnento-ka suru tame no shiyō wa dore ka.
questions.en: In Java, which specification componentizes reusable functions?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
JavaBeans are reusable building blocks.

Technical breakdown:
JavaBeans is Java component specification for reusable functionality.

Japanese keywords to remember:
仕様 = shiyō = specification

Why the best solution works:
ア names JavaBeans.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ is scripting language. ウ is a program type. エ is client-downloaded Java program.

Memory trick:
Beans = reusable components.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: Web環境での動的処理を実現するプログラムであって、Webサーバ上だけで動作するものはどれか。
questions.romaji: Web kankyō de no dōteki shori o jitsugen suru puroguramu de atte, Web sāba-jō dake de dōsa suru mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which dynamic Web program runs only on the Web server?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Servlet is chef in server kitchen; browser only receives meal.

Technical breakdown:
Java servlet executes server-side. JavaScript, applet, and VBScript are client-side in this context.

Japanese keywords to remember:
サーブレット = sāburetto = servlet

Why the best solution works:
ウ runs on Web server.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア and エ run in browser; イ executes on client.

Memory trick:
Servlet = server.

Correct answer: ウ

questions.jp: コンパイル済みのオブジェクトコードがサーバに格納されていて、クライアントからの要求によってクライアントへ転送されて実行されるプログラムはどれか。
questions.romaji: Konpairu-zumi no obujekuto kōdo ga sāba ni kakunō sarete ite, kuraianto kara no yōkyū ni yotte kuraianto e tensō sarete jikkō sareru puroguramu wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which program is downloaded from a server and executed on the client?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
An applet travels to the client to run.

Technical breakdown:
Compiled applet code is stored on a server, downloaded on request, and runs client-side.

Japanese keywords to remember:
アプレット = apuretto = applet

Why the best solution works:
ア matches download and client execution.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ runs server-side. ウ is a general script. エ is an execution unit.

Memory trick:
Applet goes to the app side.

Correct answer: ア

questions.jp: HTML文書の文字の大きさ、文字の色、行間などの視覚表現の情報を扱う標準仕様はどれか。
questions.romaji: HTML bunsho no moji no ōkisa, moji no iro, gyōkan nado no shikaku hyōgen no jōhō o atsukau hyōjun shiyō wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which standard handles HTML visual presentation such as font size, color, and line spacing?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
CSS is clothing for HTML content.

Technical breakdown:
CSS defines presentation such as font size, text color, and line spacing.

Japanese keywords to remember:
視覚表現 = shikaku hyōgen = visual presentation

Why the best solution works:
イ is CSS.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア manages content. ウ is a feed format. エ is a collaborative page system.

Memory trick:
CSS = color, size, spacing.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: XMLの特徴として、最も適切なものはどれか。
questions.romaji: XML no tokuchō to shite, mottomo tekisetsu na mono wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which is the most appropriate feature of XML?

options.label: ア
options.jp: XMLでは、HTMLに、Webページの表示性能の向上を主な目的とした機能を追加している。
options.romaji: XML dewa, HTML ni, Web pēji no hyōji seinō no kōjō o shuna mokuteki to shita kinō o tsuika shite iru.
options.en: XML adds HTML functions mainly to improve page display.

options.label: イ
options.jp: XMLでは、ネットワークを介した情報システム間のデータ交換を容易にするために、任意のタグを定義することができる。
options.romaji: XML dewa, nettowāku o kaishita jōhō shisutemu-kan no dēta kōkan o yōi ni suru tame ni, nin'i no tagu o teigi suru koto ga dekiru.
options.en: XML allows custom tags to ease data exchange between information systems.

options.label: ウ
options.jp: XMLで用いることができるスタイル言語は、HTMLと同じものである。
options.romaji: XML de mochiiru koto ga dekiru sutairu gengo wa, HTML to onaji mono de aru.
options.en: XML uses the same style language as HTML.

options.label: エ
options.jp: XMLは、SGMLを基に開発されたHTMLとは異なり、独自の仕様として開発された。
options.romaji: XML wa, SGML o moto ni kaihatsu sareta HTML to wa kotonari, dokuji no shiyō to shite kaihatsu sareta.
options.en: XML was developed independently unlike SGML-based HTML.

questions.explanation:
ELI5:
XML labels data so different systems can exchange it.

Technical breakdown:
XML allows arbitrary tags and structured data exchange across information systems.

Japanese keywords to remember:
任意のタグ = nin'i no tagu = custom tag

Why the best solution works:
イ states XML's custom-tag exchange purpose.

Wrong answer analysis:
ア confuses presentation. ウ is false. エ is historically false.

Memory trick:
XML = exchange markup labels.

Correct answer: イ

questions.jp: JavaScriptの非同期通信の機能を使うことによって、動的なユーザーインタフェースを画面全体の遷移を伴わずに実現する技術はどれか。
questions.romaji: JavaScript no hidōki tsūshin no kinō o tsukau koto ni yotte, dōteki na yūzā intāfeisu o gamen zentai no sen'i o tomonawazu ni jitsugen suru gijutsu wa dore ka.
questions.en: Which technology uses asynchronous JavaScript communication for dynamic UI without a full-page transition?
questions.explanation:
ELI5:
Ajax updates one part of a page instead of reloading everything.

Technical breakdown:
Ajax means Asynchronous JavaScript and XML; asynchronous communication enables partial dynamic updates.

Japanese keywords to remember:
非同期通信 = hidōki tsūshin = asynchronous communication

Why the best solution works:
ア updates UI without full-page navigation.

Wrong answer analysis:
イ styles pages. ウ is a feed format. エ is a social-network service.

Memory trick:
Ajax = async update.

Correct answer: ア
